purpose: Score new closed V1.7 12H keys with the already fitted test_2026 LightGBM booster, without reading any trade outcome or fitting new parameters.
single_variable: Calendar extension only; generate current source features on native hourly aggregates, including the exact sum of 5m close times base volume, native BTC returns/EMA, original source age, and simultaneous raw-signal count. The frozen booster scores only its original 632-contract roster; eight authentic supplemental contracts contribute raw same-close events to n_same_bar and remain unscored.
parity: Validate frozen 632-name reconstructed probabilities against published 2026 out-of-time probabilities before 2026-09-22, preserving the original score and candidate order. Also record the counterfactual 640-name n_same_bar and score for this overlap. From 2026-09-22 onwards, new scored candidates use the 640-name contemporaneous raw-signal count. Supply actual aligned 5m volume/turnover for the original 632-model warmup. Retain a candidate as unscored when new valid volume or cross-venue context is unavailable.
